title: D2 — 1-D radial transport + profile evolution (M03 headline physics)
origin: experiments/teamflow/m03-brainstorm-decision.md: D2 ranked #1 (BaselineAdvance 0.89, EduHelpfulness 0.67); dependency C1 sweep harness ACCEPTED 2026-09-19.

scope.goal: Add a 1-D radial (rho) transport model that evolves ne(rho,t), Te(rho,t), Ti(rho,t) inside the existing 0-D shot framework, producing core-vs-edge profiles as a new observable.
in: Flux-surface-averaged 1-D diffusion equations for particles and electron/ion energy with prescribed (parameterized) transport coefficients D, chi_e, chi_i and the existing 0-D sources (NBI, ECH, gas, ohmic, bremsstrahlung) distributed radially by documented deposition shapes.
Fixed boundary at the existing shaped Solov'ev boundary; rho grid on the reconstructed flux-surface volume from the 0.1.0 equilibrium.
Volume integrals of the profiles must reproduce the 0-D N, We, Wi balances to a stated tolerance (the 0-D model becomes the integral constraint, not a competitor).
Verification fixtures with analytic solutions; conservation ledger; grid/time-step convergence; sweep coverage via the C1 harness (python/d3gate/sweep.py).
Full five-part package per science/NEW-PHYSICS-REQUIREMENTS.md, versioned and hash-bound to the spec; physics model version bump 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 via change-request.
out: Free-boundary equilibrium, MHD/stability limits, impurities, fusion yield (D6, separate unit), sawteeth, pedestal/H-mode transition physics, neoclassical or turbulent transport closures (coefficients are prescribed, not derived).
Any change to 0.1.0 constants, assumptions, or the accepted M01/M02 baseline outputs when the profile model is disabled; the 0-D path must remain bit-for-bit identical.
Web-app changes (display work is a later, separate unit; no LLM/orchestration in the app).

successCriteria: Analytic verification: steady-state uniform-source diffusion reproduces the closed-form profile to <=1e-6 relative L2 on a converged grid; transient decay matches the eigenmode solution to <=1e-4.
Conservation: radially integrated particle and energy ledgers close to <=1e-8 relative per step against the applied sources/sinks.
Convergence: profile observables converge at the expected order under grid and dt refinement, documented with rates.

0-D parity: with the profile model disabled, all existing tests (tests/, python/tests/) and the M01 baseline experiments/baseline/m01-shot.json are unchanged; with it enabled, volume-integrated N, We, Wi agree with the 0-D balances within a stated budget.

Reference pathway: at least one established 1-D transport code named with version/source and an equation/unit/boundary mapping and matched benchmark, or a documented search and rationale if none is reachable.
Independent validation (claude-opus, distinct from implementation on claude-sonnet) attempts falsification: sweeps, edge cases, convergence, conservation. Jev audits every stage; batched.

roles.physics: claude-sonnet — spec proposal + five-part package + change-request draft
roles.software: claude-sonnet — implementation in physics/, tests/, python/, docs/
roles.auditor: jev-latest — every stage, one batched call over one state

artifacts.implement: physics/ (new transport module, engine opt-in), tests/, python/d3gate/, docs/PHYSICS.md

risks: Coefficient choice is a modeling choice, not physics: must be declared illustrative with ranges, never presented as calibrated.
Source deposition shapes need primary-source citations; inherited numbers must be flagged as unread if not verified.
0-D/1-D consistency could tempt silent tuning of 0.1.0 constants — forbidden without a change-request.
